jobs.title: Environmental and Social Specialist
jobs.description:
Hydrology & Surface Water Expert (Roster - Multiple Locations)

Organization

CTG (Committed To Good)

Posted 22 May 2026 Closing date 31 Dec 2026

Overview of position

About The CTG Roster

The CTG Talent Roster is a pre-vetted talent pool designed to support rapid deployment when suitable assignments arise with development, humanitarian, government, and institutional partners. Joining the roster is not an immediate job offer. Candidates who successfully complete screening may be contacted for future opportunities that match their expertise, availability, mobility preferences, and commercial expectations.
Roster membership is typically valid for up to three (3) years and may be renewed based on continued relevance of experience, candidate availability, performance feedback, and programme demand. Rostered candidates may be considered for short-term, long-term, on-site, hybrid, or advisory assignments across multiple regions, including the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and other locations, depending on project needs.

Purpose Of The Role

To provide mid-to-senior technical expertise in hydrology, surface water assessment, water resources analysis, hydrological modelling, hydroinformatics, integrated water resources management (IWRM), water resilience, desalination-linked planning, water reuse, and sustainable water resource management to support evidence-based planning and climate-resilient water systems

Contract Type

This vacancy is to create a pre-vetted roster. Based on client/project needs, different contract modalities may be used, including fixed-term, project-based, consultancy, retainer, remote, hybrid or on-site assignments.

Roster Duration

Up to 3 years, renewable based on continued relevance, availability, performance feedback, and programme demand

Potential Duty Stations

Multiple locations globally, with potential assignments in water-scarce, arid, semi-arid, and climate-affected contexts, including the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and other regions.

Role objectives

Hydrology & Surface Water Analysis

Conduct hydrological assessments, watershed studies, river basin analysis, runoff estimation, flood/drought risk analysis, and surface water availability assessments.
Analyse rainfall, streamflow, catchment, water balance, climate, and hydrometeorological data to support planning and decision-making.
Support assessment of surface water-groundwater interactions where relevant.
Contribute to technical studies in arid, semi-arid, water-scarce, or climate-sensitive environments.

Modelling, Data & Technical Systems

Develop, review, or support hydrological models using relevant tools and methodologies.
Work with GIS, remote sensing, hydroinformatics, water databases, monitoring networks, and related digital water information systems, where relevant to the assignment.
Support technical assessments related to non-conventional water resources, including desalination integration, treated wastewater reuse, water recovery, and climate-resilient water supply approaches where relevant.
Collaborate with hydrogeologists, GIS specialists, data analysts, engineers, economists, and policy advisors.

IWRM, SDG6 & Advisory Support

Provide technical inputs into IWRM frameworks, SDG6-related planning, water allocation, water demand assessment, and sustainable water resources management.
Translate technical hydrology outputs into clear policy, planning, and management recommendations.
Support government counterparts and programme teams with technical advice, presentations, and decision-ready analysis.

Reporting & Knowledge

Prepare technical reports, maps, data summaries, modelling notes, presentations, and advisory briefs.
Document assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations in a clear and auditable manner.

Project reporting

This role reports to the line manager.

Key competencies

Education

University degree in Hydrology, Water Resources Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Hydroinformatics, Water Resources Management, Geography, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred for senior technical assignments.

Experience

5–20 years of progressively responsible experience in hydrology, surface water analysis, water resources management, hydrological modelling, hydroinformatics, or related technical disciplines..
Candidates will be assessed and aligned to appropriate assignments based on their level of experience, technical depth, and seniority.
Experience with surface water modelling, IWRM, SDG6, GIS, hydroinformatics, or water data systems is strongly preferred.
Experience in arid, semi-arid, drought-prone, water-scarce, or climate-sensitive contexts is an advantage.

Technical Skills

Hydrological assessment, watershed analysis, water balance, and surface water modelling.
Experience with relevant tools such as HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, SWAT, MIKE, WEAP, ArcGIS, QGIS, remote sensing platforms, or comparable systems.
Ability to analyse and interpret hydrometeorological, climate, spatial, and water resources data.
Understanding of IWRM, SDG6, climate resilience, water demand, and water governance concepts.
Strong technical writing and ability to communicate complex findings to policy and non-technical audiences.

Language Requirements

Fluency in English is required.
Arabic language skills are an advantage, particularly for Middle East-based assignments with government-facing activities.

Other Requirements

Ability to work in multicultural and interdisciplinary teams.
Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and report-writing skills.
Willingness to work in diverse programme environments, including on-site, hybrid, or advisory arrangements depending on assignment needs.

Team management

Team management experience is desired for this role.

Further information

What joining CTG roster means for you:HAT JOINING THE CTG ROSTER MEANS FOR YOU

Inclusion in a pre-vetted talent pool for future assignments;
Faster consideration when relevant opportunities arise;
Potential access to assignments that may not be publicly advertised;
Ongoing visibility across CTG-supported development and institutional programmes.

Important Considerations

Selected candidates may be considered for opportunities across multiple regions and operating contexts, depending on programme requirements, candidate availability, mobility preferences, and eligibility.
Information and claims submitted as part of this application, including those relating to technical experience, employment history, education, qualifications, certifications, and PSQ responses, may be verified during the screening, background check, reference check, and deployment process, depending on assignment requirements.
Candidate information will be handled in accordance with applicable confidentiality and data protection practices and used solely for roster management and assignment-related purposes.
Rostered candidates may periodically be invited to confirm continued interest, update availability, refresh CVs, or validate technical and commercial information to maintain active roster status.

jobs.title: IC 2027 Remote Sensing Architecture Systems MTS
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Internship conversion position for the Surveillance & Navigation Architecture Performance Department
.

Job Summary

The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against a diverse and dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities.

The Surveillance and Navigation Architecture Performance Department (SNAPD) in the Integrated Performance Subdivision aspires to be the premier force advising the evolution of national security and civil space enterprises, leveraging our modeling and simulation (M&S) expertise to evaluate end-to-end architecture performance.

Within SNAPD, the Remote Sensing Architecture Section (RSAS) develops and maintains technical capabilities in modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) to perform requirements verification, analyses-of-alternatives (AoA), and performance evaluation for remote sensing architectures.

Work Model

The selected candidate will be required to work a minimum of 4 days on-site at our facility in El Segundo, California.

What You’ll Be Doing

Support analysis in one or more of these specific mission areas: geo-spatial intelligence, signals intelligence, space surveillance, navigation systems, and/or space protection supporting defense or intelligence capabilities.
Provide analysis to support recommendations for research, development, and acquisition decisions of legacy and emerging customer space-based sensing architectures.
Perform architecture evaluation modeling overall performance using in-house or custom-developed analysis tools.
Work closely with senior staff, management, and a team to translate customer needs into project objectives and provide quality controlled and assured deliverables to customer organizations
Develop and present timely and technically accurate presentations and reports that clearly communicate analysis results and provide recommended solutions to technical leads, management, and customers.
Grow awareness of analysis outcomes to provide initial assessments when needed and defend unanticipated results to both internal and external stakeholders.
Aid in sustainment, development, and growth of the organization’s analysis and simulation capabilities to support increasing functional areas for our diverse customer base.
Carry out analysis driving recommendations for research, development, and acquisition decisions for legacy and emerging remote sensing architectures
Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed
Training and mentorship will be provided

What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring

Strong written and oral communication skills
Must work well in a team environment
Possess organizational, time management and project management skills
Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational needs
Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations

Minimum Requirements

What You Need to be Successful

Master’s degree from an accredited college/university program in aerospace engineering, physics, operations research, mathematics, or a related field from an accredited program. (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)
0-1 years of relevant professional, technical work experience post bachelor’s degree
Prior internship at The Aerospace Corporation
Minimum GPA of 3.0 with transcripts
Familiarity with one or more software languages that may include Python, C/C++, and/or High-Performance Computing/Linux environments.
This position requires ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

Current, active TS/SCI security clearance or SAP accesses
Significant experience in one or more of the functional/mission areas listed above
Knowledge of Intelligence Community or US Department of Defense business practices, acquisition policies, or space mission portfolios
Demonstrated responsible professional engineering/scientific experience, to include the ability to:
Self-manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and deliverables
Maintain deliverable quality and manage customer expectations
Take direction, work independently, and develop productive working relationships
Interact and collaborate across a diverse team in different locations

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$100,000.00 - $110,000.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

Operate Strategically
Lead Change  
Engage with Impact  
Foster Innovation  
Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

Comprehensive health care and wellness plans
Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation
Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire
Flexible spending accounts
Variable pay program for exceptional contributions
Relocation assistance
Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career
Education assistance programs
An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . jobs.title: Drone Pilot Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
TUCUXI Global Solutions Pvt Ltd has been providing IT hardware and storage solutions for 14 years. The company is an authorized IBM importer and distributor of backup media tapes across India and specializes in IBM backup and storage media solutions. Its offerings include media tape accessories such as barcode labels and storage safes, as well as backup tape libraries and drives. TUCUXI also undertakes rate contracts for a variety of IT peripherals and accessories, serving enterprise clients with reliable, long-term solutions.
Role Description
The Drone Pilot Engineer will operate and manage drones and UAV systems for various industrial and commercial applications, ensuring safe and efficient flight operations. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning missions, conducting pre-flight and post-flight inspections, monitoring flight performance, and maintaining equipment in accordance with safety standards and regulations. The role involves collecting and analyzing aerial data, coordinating with technical and operations teams, and contributing to training materials or sessions related to drone usage. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular presence at the company’s facilities and project locations.
Qualifications

Strong skills in Drone Piloting with hands-on experience operating Drones and UAV systems.
Proficiency in Piloting techniques and familiarity with Training practices for drone operations.
Knowledge of aviation safety standards, local regulations related to UAV use, and risk management in flight operations.
Technical understanding of drone hardware, sensors, batteries, and basic troubleshooting.
Ability to interpret aerial data, create basic reports, and collaborate with engineering or operations teams.
Good communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured procedures and checklists.
Relevant certification or license for professional drone piloting, where applicable; engineering or technical diploma/degree is an advantage.

jobs.title: Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist
jobs.description:
Role
: Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist
Location
: Ravena, New York, United States

Role Overview:

We are seeking a dedicated, proactive Operational Safety Support Specialist to champion jobsite safety, conduct EHS audits, and promote an injury-free workplace culture at our manufacturing facility in Ravena, New York, United States. You will perform daily plant inspections, lead safety training sessions, conduct root-cause incident analyses, and partner with plant leadership to ensure complete OSHA and MSHA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct daily safety walkthroughs, hazard identifications, and regulatory compliance audits across plant operations.
Facilitate employee safety training programs, new-hire EHS orientations, and daily safety toolbox talks.
Assist in root cause investigations for near-misses, injuries, and environmental incidents, developing corrective action plans.
Maintain OSHA logs, incident reporting systems, safety data sheets (SDS), and environmental compliance documentation.
Collaborate with plant management to implement ergonomic improvements and personal protective equipment (PPE) programs.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
2+ years of EHS or operational safety experience in a manufacturing, heavy industrial, or construction environment.
In-depth knowledge of OSHA 1910/1926 standards, MSHA regulations, and industrial hygiene practices.
Strong presentation, interpersonal, and written communication skills with the ability to influence positive safety behaviors.
ASP, CSP, or OSHA 30-hour certification is preferred.

More About the Opportunity:

Make a direct, meaningful impact on employee well-being within a premier, safety-centric industrial manufacturing plant. Enjoy a competitive salary package, annual safety performance bonuses, comprehensive health coverage, and 401(k) matching. We provide corporate sponsorship for professional safety certifications including ASP, CSP, and OSHA trainer accreditations. Experience high management visibility, continuous professional education, and strong long-term career advancement pathways.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to safety, diversity, equity, and mutual respect across every facility. All qualified applicants receive fair consideration without discrimination regarding race, color, religion, sex, age, or disability. We evaluate safety professionals on technical regulatory expertise, communication skills, and personal integrity. Our organization believes that an inclusive, respectful workplace is essential to maintaining world-class jobsite safety.

Apply Now!

Role

Location
: Ravena, New York, United States

Role Overview:

We are seeking a dedicated, proactive Operational Safety Support Specialist to champion jobsite safety, conduct EHS audits, and promote an injury-free workplace culture at our manufacturing facility in Ravena, New York, United States. You will perform daily plant inspections, lead safety training sessions, conduct root-cause incident analyses, and partner with plant leadership to ensure complete OSHA and MSHA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct daily safety walkthroughs, hazard identifications, and regulatory compliance audits across plant operations.
Facilitate employee safety training programs, new-hire EHS orientations, and daily safety toolbox talks.
Assist in root cause investigations for near-misses, injuries, and environmental incidents, developing corrective action plans.
Maintain OSHA logs, incident reporting systems, safety data sheets (SDS), and environmental compliance documentation.
Collaborate with plant management to implement ergonomic improvements and personal protective equipment (PPE) programs.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
2+ years of EHS or operational safety experience in a manufacturing, heavy industrial, or construction environment.
In-depth knowledge of OSHA 1910/1926 standards, MSHA regulations, and industrial hygiene practices.
Strong presentation, interpersonal, and written communication skills with the ability to influence positive safety behaviors.
ASP, CSP, or OSHA 30-hour certification is preferred.

More About the Opportunity:

Make a direct, meaningful impact on employee well-being within a premier, safety-centric industrial manufacturing plant. Enjoy a competitive salary package, annual safety performance bonuses, comprehensive health coverage, and 401(k) matching. We provide corporate sponsorship for professional safety certifications including ASP, CSP, and OSHA trainer accreditations. Experience high management visibility, continuous professional education, and strong long-term career advancement pathways.

All qualified applicants receive fair consideration without discrimination regarding race, color, religion, sex, age, or disability. We evaluate safety professionals on technical regulatory expertise, communication skills, and personal integrity. Our organization believes that an inclusive, respectful workplace is essential to maintaining world-class jobsite safety.
